title: Other downloadable reports do not carry the joined Title - Description text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
  5. Download, for today, each other report the Report Name list offers.
  6. Search each of those files for "Replace tie rod - excessive play".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play".

Step 5:

  • Each other report downloads.

Step 6:

  • No other file contains "Replace tie rod - excessive play". A file may show "Replace tie rod" or "excessive play" on its own; that is correct.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R11: “No other report or export reads this line text. Changing it changes these two routes and nothing else.”
  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. Built at the same moment, the two never show different text for the same line, apart from the leading apostrophe the report adds in S3-R8a. An invoice already in QuickBooks keeps its old text there (S3-N1, S3-E4).”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “That text is built in one place and is used by both routes into QuickBooks: the live QuickBooks Online sync, and the downloadable Customer Invoice report. One change fixes both, and the two can never drift apart.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
